Indel Signature InsDel1a

InsDel1a

Note

InsDel_D and InsDel1a as extracted in the 89-type classification have cosine similarity of 0.91 and as extracted in the 476-type classification have cosine similarity of 0.95. On balance we think they are different because of the deletions with microhomology in InsDel1a and the deletions of single Ts in long poly-T contexts in InsDel_D.

(corresponds to 83-type signature C_ID1)

Note

89-type and 476-type extractions of InsDel1a, 1b, 1c, and 1d all collapse to profiles very similar to C_ID1, with the only slight exception being InsDel1b, which has about 8% T insertions in long poly-T contexts, a feature C_ID1 lacks.
